language.name: English
player.mini: Mini player (only this bar) / full window
player.seek: Position: drag to jump in the track
conn.unreachable: The music share is unreachable. Is WireGuard/VPN on?
genres.empty_scanning: Genres will appear as the scan goes.
genres.empty_configured: The library is empty. Refresh it in Settings.
genres.empty_unconfigured: The library is empty. Set up a server in Settings.
merge.title: Merge “{name}” into:
settings.no_server_on: Switch on at least one server: the library has nothing to read from.
settings.password_keep: leave empty to keep the saved one
settings.missing_password_primary: Enter the main server's password: the server, share or username is new, so there is no saved password.
settings.missing_password_secondary: Enter the backup server's password: the server, share or username is new, so there is no saved password.
settings.reset_title: Reset all settings to their defaults?
settings.reset_text: Volume, crossfade, output device, volume normalization, notifications, start at login and the last genre selection go back to their defaults. The language stays.
settings.reset_keep_servers: The server settings and passwords stay.
settings.reset_forget_text: The server settings are cleared and their passwords are deleted from the keychain.
settings.clear_text: Every track is removed from the library, with the genre merges, banned tracks, the list of unreadable files and the shuffle history. A running scan and the music stop. The settings and the music on the server stay. Refresh the library afterwards to read it again.
unreadable.hint: Files that could not be played or whose tags could not be read. Banned tracks are in Settings.
unreadable.copy_failed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
unreadable.reason_timeout: The server did not answer in time
scan.done: Library refreshed: {files}. New or changed: {read}, unreadable: {failed}, removed: {removed}.

scan.skipped_dirs.one: {n} folder could not be read; its tracks were kept.
scan.skipped_dirs.other: {n} folders could not be read; their tracks were kept.

scan.cancelled_settings: The server settings changed, so the scan was cancelled.
scan.cancelled_clear: The library was cleared, so the scan was cancelled.
err.autostart: Settings saved, but start at login could not be changed.
err.no_backup: No backup server is set up.
err.keychain: Cannot save the password in the keychain: {error}
err.keychain_delete: Cannot delete the password from the keychain: {error}
err.clear_busy: The scan did not stop, so the library was not cleared. Try again.
settings.close_to_tray: Closing the window keeps fxmp in the tray (off: closing quits)
settings.mic_duck: While the microphone is in use (calls)
mic.ask_body: Open fxmp to lower or pause the music.
err.playlist_changed: The playlist changed meanwhile. Try again.
err.lookup_nothing: There is nothing to look up.
playlist.new_text: The current playlist is replaced; the playing track plays on. Then add tracks from Artists: right-click a track, or use + on an album.
playlist.manual_hint: Tracks added by hand (+) play once per pass: when a shuffle starts its next pass, they are not in it.
playlist.manual_row: Added by hand: plays once per pass
playlist.empty: The playlist is empty. Click a genre, or add tracks from Artists.
playlist.no_match: No track in the playlist matches the filter.
playlist.export_text: The file lists the songs with paths relative to the music folder, so save it in the root of the music folder ({folder}); players then find the songs.
menu.ban_text: It is skipped from now on. Settings → Banned tracks brings it back.
migrate.failed: Couldn't copy your library and settings from SMB Music Player. Quit SMB Music Player, then quit fxmp and start it again: it tries again on every start until the copy works. Until then fxmp starts empty, and what you set up now is not kept.
about.version_hint: The version is also at the bottom of the menu bar icon's menu.
conn.missing: Music folder not found. Is the disk connected?
scan.offline: Not reachable, their tracks were kept: {names}.
scan.from_backup: Scanned from the backup server, nothing removed: {names}.
err.missing_password: Enter the password: the server, share or username is new, so there is no saved password.
err.no_library: That library is not set up.
err.remove_default: The main server cannot be removed; switch it off instead.
err.remove_busy: The scan did not stop, so the library was not removed. Try again.
libraries.title: Libraries
libraries.note: Music from every library that is on plays together: genres, shuffle, artists and the playlist span them all. A file that is in two libraries shows up twice.
libraries.name: Name
libraries.main_note: The main server's settings are in the form above.
libraries.remove_text: Its {tracks} leave the catalog, with their bans, loudness and failures, and its passwords are deleted from the keychain. The music files stay where they are.
scan.looks_empty: The folder looks empty, nothing removed: {names}. If its music really is gone, remove the library in Settings (for the main server: Clear library).
err.catalog_pending: The catalog still has to be updated for libraries; restart the app to scan this library.
